summary: Regression API suite and frontend smoke pass. Admin/member httpOnly cookie auth and valid OTP work. Local configured-origin OPTIONS returns 200, while the public preview OPTIONS still returns 400; repeated invalid admin logins are not locked out.

critical.issue: No brute-force lockout or throttling after 5 failed attempts; six consecutive invalid password requests all returned 401 and remained unrestricted.

minor.issue: Direct local preflight from the configured public origin returns 200 with allow-origin, but the public preview preflight returns 400 Disallowed CORS origin. This is likely proxy/runtime Origin handling rather than the app middleware; direct public credentialed POSTs work.
Existing admin password is not reconciled when the configured/expected password changes; seed only inserts when the user is absent.

action_items: Add server-side failed-login tracking with lockout/throttling after 5 attempts.
Investigate preview proxy forwarding/rewriting of Origin on OPTIONS requests; local middleware configuration is correct.
Make admin seed idempotently update the existing admin password from configured seed credentials, if password rotation is required.
critical_code_review_comments: Authentication has no brute-force protection despite the auth test requirement.
Member portal UI is static/mock data and does not use the authenticated member_token or /api/member/me; renewal action is non-functional.
WHATSAPP, object storage, and development OTP delivery remain intentionally MOCKED/DISABLED.

success_rate.backend: 100% core regression; auth hardening requirement failed

seed_data_creation: The regression suite created TEST Plan API and TEST API Member records; existing seeded members were used. No manual seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Four regression tests pass. Browser admin login/dashboard, member search, member portal navigation, and logout pass without console errors. Recheck brute-force lockout and public OPTIONS after fixes; verify member portal is wired to member_token if that flow is made functional.
rca of the issue: Local FastAPI CORSMiddleware sees the configured origin and returns a valid 200 preflight. The public ingress returns 400 before/around the application CORS decision for the same Origin/request headers, while public credentialed POST login and OTP requests succeed. The lockout gap is directly visible in server.py: login only bcrypt-checks credentials and has no failure counter, delay, or account/IP lock state.
